root.name: プロクター・アンド・ギャンブル

relations.text: ウォルマートとその関連会社向けの売上は、総売上の約16%を占める
relations.text_en: Sales to Walmart and its affiliates are about 16% of total sales

source.label: P&G 10-K(2026年6月30日終了年度)
source.quote: Sales to Walmart Inc. and its affiliates represent approximately 16% of our total sales in 2026, 2025 and 2024.

relations.text: ソーンを38億ドルで買収する契約を2026年8月4日に結んだ
relations.text_en: P&G agreed on August 4, 2026 to acquire Thorne for $3.8 billion

source.label: P&G 10-K(2026年6月30日終了年度)
source.quote: On August 4, 2026, the Company entered into an agreement to acquire Thorne, a premium wellness and supplement brand in the vitamins, minerals and supplements category for $3.8 billion.

relations.text: Glad事業の合弁契約は2026年1月に満了した
relations.text_en: The Glad joint venture agreement with Clorox expired in January 2026

source.label: P&G Form 8-K (2026-07-29)
source.quote: In January 2026, the Glad joint venture agreement between the Company and Clorox expired.
